name: One for One
text: Send 1 monster from your hand to the GY; Special Summon 1 Level 1 monster from your hand or Deck.

name: Foolish Burial
text: Send 1 monster from your Deck to the GY.

name: Pot of Desires
text: Banish 10 cards from the top of your Deck, face-down; draw 2 cards.

name: D.D. Crow
text: You can discard this card to the GY; banish 1 card from your opponent's GY.
